generation_prompt: The robot grasps the tall red glass around its sides with its right hand and lifts it from the tabletop. It carries the glass to the blue plate while tipping it sideways, lowers it across the plate, and opens its fingers with the glass lying on its side. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: The red glass lies on its side across the blue plate, with its open rim toward the left and base beside the right palm. The right thumb and fingers are opening around the base; the hand has not withdrawn. The left hand remains open away from the action.

arm_hand_roles.right: Only manipulating hand: approaches, closes fingers around the glass, lifts, transports, tips sideways, lowers across the plate and opens its fingers.
arm_hand_roles.left: Open hand remains raised away from the glass and plate; no stabilizing contact, transfer, or coordinated manipulation is visible.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Single-hand manipulation; no hand-to-hand transfer or person interaction.

uncertainties: At the ending, the right hand remains close to the glass base. The fingers visibly open and the glass lies sideways on the plate, but complete clearance of every finger from the partly occluded base and subsequent stability after withdrawal are not shown.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
